verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS and self-hostable monitoring platform with SDKs and a CLI, but the evidence pack never documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. Self-hosting is a different capability that avoids the hosted service rather than switching off tracking, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
